title: NLC Abandons Stadium Ceremony for Nationwide Protest, Demands ₦154,000 Minimum Wage
detail: The Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) abandoned the traditional Workers' Day stadium rally on May 1, instead leading nationwide street protests demanding an upward revision of the national minimum wage from ₦70,000 to ₦154,000. NLC President Joe Ajaero cited an inflation rate of 15.38% in March, soaring fuel prices, and estimated youth unemployment of 80% as making the 2024 wage figure already inadequate. The protests underscored widening cost-of-living pressures following the 2023 fuel subsidy removal and the naira devaluation.

media.caption: NLC workers march on May Day 2026, demanding ₦154,000 minimum wage amid rising inflation
